text:
The stones of the road fill with tenderness

and moss; the heavens gaze sweetly

at the bluish breasts of the water that stagnates.


Brightening among puddles undone by the sun,

the bitter veins of the ferns swell with light,

spread over the cool terror of the ravine.

translation.title: The Stones of the Road Fill With Tenderness
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps Urquiza's lush landscape: tender stones, stagnant water, fern veins, and ravine.
